the_reads: COMMUTE-TIME COLUMN: the 6 founder-panel city-places 2021-2024 (24 captured city-years) + Sullivan/Kingsport county-substitute. Memphis mean-commute arc 21.5/20.9/20.9/21.4 min = the flat mid-pack (the lane13 TEST-1 null replicates on the 1-YR grain: Memphis is NOT worse on commute TIME).
THE 45+ BAND: Memphis ge45-share 4.4-6.0% = lowest of the 6; NYC 40.7-41.8%, Houston 14.6-18.0% rising (Houston carries the long-commute mass on its ladder), Detroit/STL/Cincy 5.9-13.1%.

ACCESS COLUMN (the lever, replicating lane13): Memphis transit commute-share 0.47/0.56/0.78/0.55% = 7-100x below NYC, ~3-8x below the income-peer midwest set (Cincy 3.9-6.6%, STL 4.9-7.9%, Detroit 3.9-5.6%) - the service-absence signature persists across all four 1-YR vintages.

BAND-MEAN JOIN (between-city, snapshot vs snapshot): mean-commute-2024 x OEWS band-weighted-mean r=+0.963 (n=6), x p90 r=+0.929 - the commute column and the wage band move together ACROSS cities (NYC/Houston long-and-rich, Memphis/Cincy short-and-ladder-poor), but WITHIN-city the commute arc is ~flat (|delta| <= 2.8 min over 4 vintages, 6-city mean |delta| = 1.2 min) - no within-city commute lever on this window.

OH-88 CLASS: 38 of 88 OH counties clear the 1-YR line: mean-commute median 23.8 min (range 17.7-28.9), transit median 0.53%, no-vehicle median 3.3%; Hamilton (Cincinnati) at 22.9 min / 2.0% transit / 5.2% no-vehicle sits top-quartile on access within-OH.
honest_null_verdict: NULL RESULT (within-city): the mean-commute-per-city-year column shows no meaningful within-city movement on 2021-2024 - the commute-time COLUMN is a LEVEL discriminator, not a time-arc lever; the pre-registered founder test (commute -> within-city moderator block) nulls on this window and is printed as such.

DIRECTION RESULT (between-city): r(mean-commute, band-weighted-mean) = +0.963 replicates the banked band_share_x_p90 r=+0.984 class at the city grain - long-commute metros are high-band metros; the access-penalty (NOT the time-penalty) remains the differentiator, consistent with lane13 TEST-2/TEST-3.
